settings.title: Choose your Primal Strength equipment
settings.text: Browse the Primal Strength range and note the products you need.

settings.title: Contact Millennium Health & Fitness
settings.text: Ask for a quote and reference GSA MAS Contract GS-03F-021CA. Millennium will confirm which products are available under the contract.

settings.title: Place your order
settings.text: Millennium Health & Fitness, Inc. processes the order under its GSA contract terms.
